# Overview and quick start {#sec-ch01}

This chapter is the entry point to the report. @sec-ch01-pipeline states what pyharp computes, from the
concentrations in a column to the net flux at every level, and lists where each step is documented;
@sec-ch01-quickstart builds pyharp from public sources at the pins of this report and runs a first calculation whose
printed output is checked. Notation follows @sec-ch02.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ch01-map

The opacities are the subject of the opacity chapter, the solver input and the sum over spectral points of @sec-ch07, the solvers of @sec-ch03 and @sec-ch04, built on the two-stream theory of @sec-ch02, and the sum over bands of @sec-ch08; across the whole pipeline are solver accuracy (@sec-ch05), GPU and batching (@sec-ch09-toon, @sec-ch09-disort) and tests (@sec-ch10)."
#| fig-alt: "Five boxes in a row joined by arrows: opacities, solver input, solver, sum over spectral points, sum over bands, each naming the chapter that documents it. A box above the solver reads two-stream theory, with an arrow down to the solver. Below the row a bracket labelled across the whole pipeline spans three boxes: solver accuracy, GPU and batching, tests, CI, bindings. All boxes are drawn alike."
```
